description: This file defines the interface 'OrderFacade' in a Java-based e-commerce application. It declares methods related to order processing, calculation, shipping, and retrieval, serving as a facade for order-related operations between the web layer and business logic.

classes.name: OrderFacade
classes.description: An interface providing methods for handling orders in an e-commerce system, including initialization, calculation, processing, validation, and retrieval of order data.

methods.name: initializeOrder
methods.description: Prepares and returns a new order for a given store, customer, shopping cart, and language.

methods.name: refreshOrder
methods.description: Updates an existing order with current data.

methods.name: calculateOrderTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total summary of an order, used both in the website and API contexts.

methods.name: processOrder
methods.description: Finalizes an order, either directly or against a transaction, producing an Order object.

methods.name: initEmptyCustomer
methods.description: Creates an empty customer object for anonymous users.

methods.name: getShipToCountry
methods.description: Retrieves a list of countries to which the store can ship.

methods.name: getShippingQuote
methods.description: Fetches a shipping quote based on customer, cart, order, store, and language.

methods.name: getShippingSummary
methods.description: Creates a shipping summary based on a shipping quote.

methods.name: validateOrder
methods.description: Validates an order, potentially adding validation messages.

methods.name: getReadableOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a readable representation of an order by ID.

methods.name: getReadableOrderList
methods.description: Fetches a list of orders for a customer or store with pagination.
